description: React component for viewing and resolving differences between note versions, including conflict resolution UI, version restoration, and copy creation within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: DiffViewer
classes.description: React component for displaying and resolving conflicts between different versions of notes, with UI for diff viewing, conflict resolution, and version management.

methods.name: resolveConflict
methods.description: Handles the process of resolving a conflict by updating the database with the chosen content version and optionally creating a copy.

methods.name: createCopy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a note's content, handling both locked and unlocked content, and adds it to the database.
